# Show that CRDs are disjoint pre/post filtering

# Number of total CRDs + Peaks per Condition

```{r plot_CRD_counts, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 6
# #| eval: false
example_filter <- function(df){
    df %>% 
    # filter(sample.strategy != 'No.Others') %>% 
    filter(CPM.cutoff == '3CPM') %>% 
    filter(z.score.counts) %>% 
    filter(n.SVs == NUM_SVS_TO_GENERATE) %>% 
    filter(SVs.included == NUM_SVS_TO_REMOVE)
    # select(-all_of(decorate.params.list)) %>% 
    # select(-c(CPM.cutoff, z.score.counts, n.SVs, SVs.included))
}

n.CRDs.df <- 
    load_all_CRD_data(filter_fnc=example_filter) %>% 
    mutate(
        n.CRDs=
            future_pmap(
                .l=list(CRDs),
                .f=
                    ~ .x %>% 
                    mutate(n.peaks=pmap_int(.l=list(PeakList), .f=nrow)) %>% 
                    summarize(
                        .groups='drop',
                        n.CRDs=n(),
                        n.Peaks=sum(n.peaks)
                    ),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    select(-c(CRDs)) %>% 
    unnest(n.CRDs)
nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model'
        # 'AD.definition.column',
    )
n.CRDs.df %>% 
    pivot_longer(
        c(n.Peaks, n.CRDs),
        names_to='metric',
        values_to='n'
    ) %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(nesting.vars)) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_barplot,
                x.var='is.filtered',
                y.var='n',
                y.scale.mode='m',
                fill.var='sample.strategy',
                facet.col='meanClusterSize',
                facet.row='metric',
                # scales='free_y', independent='y',
                scales='free_y', independent=FALSE,
                y.axis.label.accuracy=0.1,
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=2,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```

# Compare CRD features across subsets, before and after decorate filtering + collapsing

```{r load_CRD_stats}
all.CRD.stats.df <- 
    ALL_CRD_STATS_TSV_FILEPATH %>%
    read_tsv(show_col_types=FALSE) %>% 
    filter(
        CRD.feature %in% 
            c(
                'CRD.length',              
                'CRD.nPeaks',              
                # 'mean-logFC',              
                'med-logFC',               
                # 'var-logFC',               
                # 'total-logFC',             
                'mean-log10.p.adjust',     
                # 'med-log10.p.adjust',      
                # 'var-log10.p.adjust',      
                'total-log10.p.adjust',    
                'mean-peak.length',        
                # 'med-peak.length',         
                # 'var-peak.length',         
                'total-peak.length',       
                # 'mean-peak.distanceToTSS', 
                # 'med-peak.distanceToTSS',  
                # 'total-peak.distanceToTSS',
                'mean-gene.length'
            )
    ) %>% 
    mutate(meanClusterSize=factor(meanClusterSize)) %>% 
    mutate( 
        feature.type=   
            case_when(  
                # str_detect(CRD.feature, 'length|distance') ~ 'length',
                str_detect(CRD.feature, 'length') ~ 'length',
                CRD.feature == 'CRD.nPeaks' ~ 'nPeaks',
                TRUE ~ 'differential'
            )
    )
# all.CRD.stats.df %>% count(feature.type)
```

```{r plot_CRD_stat_distributions, results='asis'}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 10
# #| eval: false

# Now plot correlation of SVs across datasets
nesting.vars <- 
    c(
        'CPM.cutoff',
        'residual.model',
        # 'AD.definition.column',
        'contrast',
        'feature.type'
    )
all.CRD.stats.df %>% 
    order_variable_for_plotting() %>% 
    nest(plot.df=-all_of(nesting.vars)) %>% 
    left_join(
        tribble(
            ~ feature.type, ~ x.scale.mode, ~ x.axis.label.accuracy,
            'length',       'mb',           0.1,
            'nPeaks',       'm',            0.1,
            'differential', '',             0.01,
        ),
        by='feature.type'
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
        figures=
            pmap(
                .l=.,
                .f=plot_boxplot,
                x.var='CRD.value',
                y.var='meanClusterSize',
                fill.var='sample.strategy',
                facet.row='is.filtered',
                facet.col='CRD.feature', 
                y.scale.mode='discrete',
                scales='free_x',
                # space='free',
                # independent='all',
                legend.position='top',
                axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=1, hjust=1),
                axis.title=element_blank(),
                .progress=TRUE
            )
    ) %>% 
    custom_render_tabset(
        starting.hlevel=2,
        output_var='figures',
        tabset_vars=nesting.vars
    )
```
